name: scope-hierarchy-ancestor-wraps
description: ScopeCrumbs hierarchy list (activity sidebar): an ancestor crumb's long, user-authored session title must wrap in full inside the sidebar width - the hierarchy view exists to show the whole ancestry, so an ancestor may not truncate to one ellipsized line (only a hover title would carry the rest, useless on touch) - and nothing may spill out of the list.

mutation.declaration: shell/statusbar/scopeCrumbs.module.css: .hierarchy .crumbWrap { white-space: normal } (deleted - both ancestor links inherit .crumbWrap's nowrap and ellipsize to one line); .hierarchy .crumbWrap { overflow-wrap: anywhere } (deleted alone - the unbroken underscore title is cut off at 542px in a 272px box)
